ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution; approximately 40% high-intensity (white) to 60% low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two distinct high-intensity (white) contiguous regions located on the distal lobes. The left distal lobe features a larger, more solid white region compared to the right. Both are bordered by high-frequency stippled mottling. Central peduncle and proximal lobe regions consist of solid low-intensity (black) pixel blocks.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch; calculated pixel angle of approximately 45 degrees at the central convergence point.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the trailing edge. Serration amplitude increases significantly at both distal tips, resulting in a jagged, irregular boundary morphology.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep trajectory from the distal tips toward the median notch; leading edge of the fluke (partially obscured) exhibits convex curvature.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of low-intensity circular pixel groups concentrated at both distal tips, consistent with barnacle colonization sites. Scattered dark pixel spots are visible within the high-intensity white fields of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible on the left high-intensity lobe, oriented diagonally from the center toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular tissue/encrustation at the distal tips; slight irregular notch on the trailing edge of the right lobe approximately 15% from the distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique asymmetrical stippling pattern at the interface of the black and white regions, with a prominent 'spray' of black pixels into the white field on the interior edge of the left lobe.
